title: Houston spells out a text message he never saw

tellings.quote: text she texted it to me he never saw the text and he spelled out what was on the text

plain: A nonspeaking young man named Houston Asher is said to have spelled out the exact words of a text message he never saw. His mother, Katie Asher, who appears with him in The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary series about nonspeaking people said to read minds, tells Michels that a woman texted her and that Houston, who had not seen the text, spelled out what was on it. If true, it would point to something like telepathy.
